ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( Is_Published__c, ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Published") ), OR( ISBLANK(Public_Job_Title__c), ISBLANK(Public_Description__c), ISBLANK(Publication_Date__c), ISBLANK(Application_Deadline__c) ) )
